name: Add Organic Search Filter to SCO - Flows
description:
As WFM, I want a filter feature on the Search screen that allows the customer to narrow their search to just organic items so that customers can locate items faster.

This Story covers the flow scenarios.

### Background: 
Business is requesting that the current organic search filter available on registers today be added to the SCO Item Search experience within the keyboard (see Figma). This will enable customers to limit returned search results to just organic products helping them locate items faster.

### Pre-requisites
1.	New configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” was created in WFM Configuration table.
2.	New configuration “OrganicFilterScope” was created in WFM Configuration table.
3.	Suggested for this feature test, verify existing configurations “ScanProduceBeforeSearch” and “PromptForProduceBarcode” are set to false [off] so there are no other prompts while in Search. 

### User Journey
***Identify test item:***
•	Identify a test item that has both organic and non-organic in the SCOPickList response sent from R10.

**DOD 1: While toggle slide is in ‘off’ position, search for test item, conventional and organic items are displayed**
1.	At Attract, press Search button
2.	Search screen displays
3.	Verify/set the organic filter toggle displays in ‘off’ position
4.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
5.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen 
6.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
7.	Select the conventional test item
8.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
9.	Itemization screen displays with conventional test item added
10.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
11.	Tender transaction using any tender type

**DOD 2: While toggle slide is in ‘on’ position, search for test item, only organic items are displayed**
1.	At Attract, press Search button
2.	Search screen displays
3.	Verify/set the organic filter toggle displays in ‘on’ position
4.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
5.	Verify only the organic of test item displays in results screen
6.	Verify other items meeting the search criteria that only the organic is displayed 
7.	Select organic test item
8.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
9.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
10.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
11.	Tender transaction using any tender type

**DOD 3: Toggle slide from ‘off’ position to ‘on’ position, and back to ‘off’ position**
1.	At Attract, press Search button
2.	Search screen displays
3.	Verify/set the organic filter toggle displays in ‘off’ position
4.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
5.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen
6.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
7.	Toggle slide to ‘on’ position
8.	Verify only the organic of test item displays in results screen
9.	Verify other items meeting the search criteria that only the organic is displayed 
10.	Toggle slide back to ‘off’ position
11.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen 
12.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
13.	Select conventional test item
14.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
15.	Itemization screen displays with conventional test item added
16.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
17.	Tender transaction using any tender type
18.	Verify in Usability Tracking file the customer interaction with the toggle is captured.

**DOD 4: With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to SEARCH and configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” set to SHOW_OFF, the toggle resets to ‘off’ after each item search**
1.	Set configuration “OrganicFilterScope” to SEARCH
2.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to SHOW_OFF
3.	At Attract, press Search button
4.	Search screen displays
5.	Verify the organic filter toggle displays in ‘off’ position as default
6.	Toggle slide to ‘on’ position
7.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
8.	Verify only the organic of test item displays in results screen
9.	Verify other items meeting the search criteria that only the organic is displayed 
10.	Select the organic test item
11.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
12.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
13.	Press Search button to return to Search screen
14.	Verify toggle has been reset to ‘off’ position
15.	Toggle slide to ‘on’ position
16.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
17.	Verify only the organic of test item displays in results screen
18.	Verify other items meeting the search criteria that only the organic is displayed 
19.	Select the organic test item
20.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
21.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
22.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
23.	Tender and complete transaction
24.	At Attract, press Search button
25.	Search screen displays
26.	Verify the filter toggle displays in ‘off’ default position

**DOD 5: With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to SEARCH and configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” set to SHOW_ON, the toggle resets to ‘on’ after each item search** 
1.	Set configuration “OrganicFilterScope” to SEARCH
2.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to SHOW_ON
3.	At Attract, press Search button
4.	Search screen displays
5.	Verify the organic filter toggle displays in ‘on’ position as default
6.	Toggle slide to ‘off’ position
7.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
8.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen 
9.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
10.	Select the organic test item
11.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
12.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
13.	Press Search button to return to Search screen
14.	Verify toggle has been reset to ‘on’ position
15.	Toggle slide to ‘off’ position
16.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
17.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen 
18.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
19.	Select the conventional test item
20.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
21.	Itemization screen displays with conventional test item added
22.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
23.	Tender and complete transaction
24.	At Attract, press Search button
25.	Search screen displays
26.	Verify the filter toggle displays in ‘on’ default position

**DOD 6: With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to TXN and configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” set to SHOW_OFF, if the customer turns on the organic filter toggle, the toggle remains in ‘on’ position for the entirety of that transaction, then resets to ‘off’ after transaction completes**
1.	Set configuration “OrganicFilterScope” to TXN
2.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to SHOW_OFF
3.	At Attract, press Search button
4.	Search screen displays
5.	Verify the organic filter toggle displays in ‘off’ position as default
6.	Toggle slide to ‘on’ position
7.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
8.	Verify only the organic of test item displays in results screen
9.	Verify other items meeting the search criteria that only the organic is displayed 
10.	Select the organic test item
11.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
12.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
13.	Press Search button to return to Search screen
14.	Verify toggle is still in the ‘on’ position
15.	Search for test item again with both conventional and organic pairing
16.	Verify only the organic of test item displays in results screen
17.	Verify other items meeting the search criteria that only the organic is displayed 
18.	Select the organic test item
19.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
20.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
21.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
22.	Tender and complete transaction
23.	At Attract, press Search button
24.	Search screen displays
25.	Verify the filter toggle displays in ‘off’ default position

**DOD 7: With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to TXN and configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” set to SHOW_ON, if the customer turns off the organic filter toggle, the toggle remains in ‘off’ position for the entirety of that transaction, then resets to ‘on’ after transaction completes**
1.	Set configuration “OrganicFilterScope” to TXN
2.	Set configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” to SHOW_ON
3.	At Attract, press Search button
4.	Search screen displays
5.	Verify the organic filter toggle displays in ‘on’ position as default
6.	Toggle slide to ‘off’ position
7.	Search for test item with both conventional and organic pairing
8.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen 
9.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
10.	Select conventional test item
11.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
12.	Itemization screen displays with conventional test item added
13.	Press Search button to return to Search screen
14.	Verify toggle is still in the ‘off’ position
15.	Search for test item again with both conventional and organic pairing
16.	Verify both conventional and organic of test item displays in results screen 
17.	Verify other paired items meeting the search criteria are displayed 
18.	Select organic test item
19.	Enter weight and container item (if applicable)
20.	Itemization screen displays with organic test item added
21.	Press Pay Now to move to Tender
22.	Tender and complete transaction
23.	At Attract, press Search button
24.	Search screen displays
25.	Verify the filter toggle displays in ‘on’ default position


### QA Considerations
1.	Test above scenarios with existing configurations “ScanProduceBeforeSearch” and “PromptForProduceBarcode” set to true [on] to verify no issues with the existing Search screen prompts.
2.	Test above scenarios in Training mode and Attendant mode.
3.	Test configuration "OrganicSearchFilter" at the Global, TPG, and BU level.
4.	Test configuration "OrganicFilterScope" at the Global, TPG, and BU level.

parentTasks.name: Add Organic Search Filter to SCO
parentTasks.description:
As WFM, I want a filter feature on the Search screen that allows the customer to narrow their search to just organic items so that customers can locate items faster.

### Background: 
Business is requesting that the current organic search filter available on registers today be added to the SCO Item Search experience within the keyboard (see Figma). This will enable customers to limit returned search results to just organic products helping them locate items faster.

### Requirements
•	As a Business, we want an organic toggle to be added to the SCO item search keyboard that limits search results to just organic products when turned on.
•	As a Business, we want customer engagement with the toggle to be tracked within usability to enable a better understanding for the business in terms of how much value this provides customers.
•	As a Business, we want the organic toggle to be delivered to WFM as "hide" (organic toggle does not display on keyboard.
•	As a Business, we want the organic toggle to be configurable as "off" (or “on”) where the organic toggle is set to off (or on) at the beginning of each customer transaction.
•	As a Business, during the customers transaction we want the ability for the organic filter to remain on/off for the entirety of the customers transaction according to customer selection (i.e organic filter remains on if customer turns on for the entirety of that customers transaction) or be configurable to resetting the organic filter to off with each item search use (i.e. organic filter defaults to off after a selection is made and customer returns back to main sales mode screen).

Mocks in Figma Hand-off File 

### Assumptions
1.	This effort is for touchpoint group: SCO
2.	This effort will impact Amazon store brand Amazon Grocery.
3.	The picklist received from R10 will have conventional and organic items paired, ranked and sorted.
4.	With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to SEARCH, any time the customer moves away from the Search screen, by either selecting an item or pressing the Back button, the toggle is to reset back to default if customer returns to Search screen.
5.	With configuration “OrganicFilterScope” set to SEARCH, if the customer searches for an item but gets message “Item Not Found”, the toggle is not reset to default since the customer is still on the Search screen.
6.	Multi-Version Impact - No impact
7.	Threat model changes - No impact
8.	Performance testing is required to test toggling to organic only search.
9.	Delivery: This epic will be delivered as part of installation package. Configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” will be delivered in “HIDE” state and configuration “OrganicFilterScope” will be delivered in SEARCH state.

### Configurations
**OrganicSearchFilter:** Create a new parameter that allows WFM to configure the organic toggle slide on Search screen to either 1) display with filter on (SHOW_ON), 2) display with filter off (SHOW_OFF), or 3) to not display the toggle slide at all (HIDE) at the store level. Defaulted to HIDE.

**OrganicFilterScope:** Create a new that allows WFM to control the display method used for the organic filter toggle at the store level. Values are TXN and SEARCH. If TXN is selected, the organic filter will remain on/off for the entirety of the transaction according to customer’s selection. If SEARCH is selected, the organic filter is reset to default setting ON/OFF with each item search use. Defaulted to SEARCH.

### What to demo
1.	Using the new configuration “OrganicSearchFilter”, WFM can configure the organic filter toggle to 1) not display in the UI, 2) display but be set to off, or 3) display but set to on.
2.	When the configuration “OrganicSearchFilter” is set to display (on or off), the filtering toggle appears on the Search screen to allow the customer to search for all items or only organic items.
3.	Using the new configuration “OrganicFilterScope”, WFM can also control the display method used for the organic filter toggle.
a.	When configured to TXN, the organic filter will remain on/off for the entirety of the transaction according to customer’s selection.
b.	When configured to SEARCH, the organic filter is reset to default setting ON/OFF with each item search use
4.	Customer engagement with the organic filter toggle is tracked in the Usability Tracking file.
